method: Every LLM-flagged switch hand-verified against the registry primaryOutcomes and the paper methods span. FALSE POSITIVES removed before rate. Each case individually checkable via the locators below.

cases.paper_locator: PMID:39350270 methods: 'The primary endpoint was the C-peptide area under the curve (C-p AUC) at 1 year.'

cases.paper_locator: PMID:34605142 methods: 'Primary GD endpoints were derived from glucose concentration profiles...'
cases.note: registry designates PK as primary; paper designates glucodynamic response — PK/PD studies often co-primary, so borderline but a genuine designation difference

cases.paper_locator: PMID:20958972 methods: 'The primary outcome for this study was the use of the HHF and the wristband after two months.'
cases.note: clinical primary (breathlessness) demoted to secondary; feasibility/usage promoted to primary

cases.reason: index paper is the POLO trial HRQoL COMPANION/secondary publication; the PFS primary is in the main NEJM paper. Not switching — index-paper-is-secondary confound.

cases.paper_primary: success rate of managing the fistula
cases.reason: 'success rate' is the complement/inverse of 'recurrence' — SAME outcome concept, complementary phrasing. Not a switch.
